query:
UPDATE embedding_reindex_runs
              SET total_rows = CASE WHEN total_rows = 0 THEN $2 ELSE total_rows END,
                  done_rows = $3,
                  status = $4,
                  last_error = $5,
                  leased_until = NULL,
                  finished_at = CASE WHEN $4 IN ('complete', 'failed') THEN now() ELSE NULL END,
                  updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = $1
